title: Screeching metal sound from main shaft
description: Lathe headstock is screaming when it spins up, vibration felt on the guard. Bearings feel rough when turned by hand.

title: Oil puddle forming under the press
description: Hydraulic fluid dripping from the ram cylinder seal since morning. Had to put absorbent pads down.

title: Conveyor drive slipping under load
description: The transfer belt keeps losing grip when boxes are heavy, product moves in jerks. Belt looks loose.

title: Drive keeps tripping the breaker
description: Main motor trips the overload relay every hour and the casing is very warm. Current reading higher than normal.

title: Proximity switch missing parts randomly
description: Part-present sensor flickers, sometimes doesn't see the part and the station halts. Cable is rubbing on the frame.

title: Panel lights flicker and controller reboots
description: Control cabinet restarts on its own when the big compressor starts. Incoming voltage seems to dip.

title: Shaft diameter measuring oversize
description: Final inspection rejecting shafts at 0.04 mm over the upper limit after the insert was changed.

title: Scuff marks on finished housings
description: Customers complaining about scratched covers. Parts are rubbing together in the bin during transfer.

title: Pinholes in weld seam
description: X-ray shows gas pockets in the seam welds. Wire spool was left open overnight in humid store.

title: Machine started without its interlock cover
description: Fixed guard was not put back after the PM job and the press was run without it.

title: Worker nearly fell on greasy floor
description: Slippery patch of lubricant next to the stamping area. Nobody cleaned the leak from yesterday.

title: Burnt odour from distribution board
description: Cable terminal at the feeder is discoloured and hot, faint crackling noise when line runs at full load.

title: Changeover taking much longer than planned
description: Die change took 70 minutes instead of 40. Each crew follows its own sequence of steps.

title: Coating finish uneven on panels
description: Film build varies a lot across the panel, booth feels damp and the exhaust filter looks blocked.

title: Line idle waiting for steel coils
description: No coils at the feeder for two hours. The reorder was triggered late and the truck had not arrived.

title: Controller halted with error code
description: The PLC stopped the program and shows a communication fault after the software update last night.

title: Output counts not showing in MES
description: Dashboard shows zero parts produced for the cell although the line is running. Barcode reader also missing scans.

title: Pick and place arm missing the target
description: Robot gripper grabs parts off-centre since the emergency stop yesterday. Alignment drifting.
